National Summary

Overall Economic Activity
Economic activity expanded at a moderate pace on balance. Outlooks weakened as contacts cited rising uncertainty.

Employment and Wages
Employment rose at a moderate pace, and hiring remained difficult amid uncertain labor supply. Wage growth was widespread.

Prices
Prices grew rapidly across the nation. Pass-through of input costs was substantial.
